fields.statement: Change set 01M6MA6P (Fix Ship's new main-tree check) serves no intent yet. Which intent should it serve? Its parent change set #256 (Update github runner) served milestone-25 (empty the backlog). / When the merge commit's tree differs from the tested head's, ship dispatches CI on main. GitHub's workflow_dispatch only accepts a branch or tag as ref, not a SHA, so `gh workflow run --ref <sha>` cannot pin the merge commit. Which commit should the dispatched run test? / Which workflows should ship dispatch when the trees differ? ship-change is generic across repos (this repo has ci.yml; `rhiza ci install` writes its own file). / If the dispatched CI run on main fails, what should wait-main/main-green do?
